_why_exclude_is_empty: `extends` INHERITS `exclude`. The base config excludes __tests__ repo-wide, so without this
reset the test entries are silently dropped from `include` and tsc exits clean over the
source files alone. Every target is confirmed with --listFiles, never assumed.
_why_the_d_ts_entries: NextAuth's Session type is MODULE-AUGMENTED in a project .d.ts. A scoped `include` that
lists only source files leaves that augmentation out of the program, and lib/auth.ts then
reports 3 phantom TS2339s ('id'/'username'/'spotifyAccount' do not exist on Session.user)
that the repo-wide run does not have and the ratchet baseline does not list. Those are an
artifact of the scoping, not defects. Verified by removing them: 14 errors -> 11.
⚠ CLAUDE.md warns that adding .d.ts entries can suppress TS18003 and hide an empty compile
set. That risk is handled the other way here: every target is confirmed present via
--listFiles, so an empty or partial set is caught by name rather than by exit code.
